title: Sororin locks the DNA-exit gate of cohesin to preserve sister-chromatid cohesion.
authors: Chen, Qinfu; Yuan, Xueying; Shi, Miao; Zhou, Xinyu; Zhu, Shukai; Lu, Weiguo; Yan, Haiyan; Wang, Fangwei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold3建模和生化实验研究Sororin锁定cohesin的DNA出口门以维持姐妹染色单体粘连，属于蛋白质-DNA互作（cohesin-DNA拓扑捕获）且含结构建模方法，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、AI建模为辅，故评5分。
abstract: The cohesin complex mediates sister-chromatid cohesion by topologically entrapping DNA within an SMC1-SMC3-RAD21 ring, yet how Sororin preserves cohesion beyond its known role of antagonizing Pds5 binding to the release factor Wapl has remained unclear. Here, we show that the extreme C-terminal region (CTR) of Sororin functions as a direct structural lock for cohesin's DNA-exit gate by engaging the RAD21-SMC3 interface. Centromere-tethered Sororin-CTR fully restores cohesion after Sororin depletion, whereas constitutive chromatin tethering prevents cohesin removal, recapitulating Wapl-loss phenotypes, including impaired mitotic chromosome condensation, decatenation and segregation. Through biochemical reconstitution, AlphaFold3-guided modeling, and targeted mutagenesis, we define conserved hydrophobic and electrostatic contacts between Sororin-CTR and the RAD21-SMC3 gate, the disruption of which abolishes cohesion in a Wapl-dependent manner. Furthermore, mitotic phosphorylation of Sororin selectively disrupts Pds5 binding while leaving gate engagement intact, providing a regulated molecular switch for cohesin release. Together, these findings redefine Sororin as a dual-function regulator that both antagonizes Wapl-Pds5 and directly locks the RAD21-SMC3 exit gate to stabilize sister-chromatid cohesion while permitting its timely dissolution.
abstract_zh: 黏连蛋白复合体通过将DNA拓扑学地捕获在SMC1-SMC3-RAD21环内来介导姐妹染色单体黏连，然而Sororin在已知的拮抗Pds5与释放因子Wapl结合的作用之外，如何维持黏连仍不清楚。在此，我们展示Sororin的极端C末端区域（CTR）通过结合RAD21-SMC3界面，作为黏连蛋白DNA出口门的直接结构锁。着丝粒锚定的Sororin-CTR在Sororin耗竭后完全恢复黏连，而组成型染色质锚定则阻止黏连蛋白移除，重现Wapl缺失的表型，包括有丝分裂染色体凝缩、去连环和分离受损。通过生化重构、AlphaFold3引导建模和靶向诱变，我们定义了Sororin-CTR与RAD21-SMC3门之间的保守疏水和静电接触，其破坏以Wapl依赖方式消除黏连。此外，有丝分裂期Sororin的磷酸化选择性破坏Pds5结合，同时保持门接合完整，为黏连蛋白释放提供受调控的分子开关。综合来看，这些发现将Sororin重新定义为双重功能调节因子，既拮抗Wapl-Pds5，又直接锁定RAD21-SMC3出口门以稳定姐妹染色单体黏连，同时允许其及时解离。
